code_hints: If a cookie banner appears, click one of selectors in consent.accept before any navigation.
If a geolocation/region modal appears, click geolocation.continue or the button that keeps United Kingdom.
Prefer starting directly from the provided PLP start_urls. If starting from homepage, open nav.men then click nav.men_down_jackets.
On PLP: wait for either plp.list or several plp.item; then auto-scroll to load more items before extracting.
Extract PDP links via plp.item_link; normalize links using url_rules before visiting.
On PDP: wait for pdp.title and pdp.price; handle prices that may render after a short delay.
rationale: The failure occurred because the homepage is not a PLP and likely showed cookie/region modals, so no product tiles appeared. We introduce safe overrides to start from stable PLPs under /en-gb/, add consent/region selectors, robust PLP item selectors, and URL normalization to keep the crawler within the en-gb locale while avoiding monclergroup.com or other locales. Auto-scroll is enabled to materialize lazy-loaded tiles.
